briefs.title: NY Fed's Williams says inflation work remains, to be tackled 'over time'
briefs.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said on Monday that policymakers have more work to do on inflation, and that action can unfold over time as the economy keeps growing. He expressed confidence that inflation will move closer to the Fed's 2% target in 2027 and reach it the following year. CNBC reports that markets fully price in a quarter percentage point rate increase at the Dec. 8-9 FOMC meeting, from the current target range of 3.75%-4%. Williams did not explicitly address those expectations.

watch.note: Compare the language with the late-October statement cited by Williams.

watch.text: Further inflation and labor data released before the next policy decision
watch.note: Check official releases against Williams' view that inflation is running too high and unemployment is edging lower.

es.title: Williams, de la Fed de Nueva York: aún hay trabajo en inflación, que se abordará «con el tiempo»
es.summary: El presidente de la Fed de Nueva York, John Williams, dijo el lunes que los responsables de política tienen más trabajo por hacer en materia de inflación y que la acción puede desarrollarse con el tiempo mientras la economía sigue creciendo. Expresó confianza en que la inflación se acercará a la meta de 2% de la Fed en 2027 y la alcanzará al año siguiente. Según CNBC, los mercados descuentan por completo un alza de un cuarto de punto porcentual en la reunión del FOMC del 8 y 9 de diciembre, desde el rango objetivo actual de 3,75%-4%. Williams no abordó de forma explícita esas expectativas.

briefs.title: Ecopetrol's president says no date is set for fracking in Colombia, citing pending environmental rules
briefs.summary: Ecopetrol president Joaquín Gutiérrez told El Tiempo that the company's technical teams are updating prospectivity and structuring business cases for unconventional reservoirs, using seismic and well data acquired in recent years. He said there is currently no specific date to implement fracking in Colombia and that it is not appropriate to discuss production timelines or definitive investments until the business cases and the environmental, social and risk diagnostics are completed. He added that Colombian law currently has no rule allowing an environmental license for the commercial stage of unconventional reservoirs, because the terms of reference for the environmental impact studies are still pending. The report notes that reactivating fracking through Ecopetrol was a promise of the De la Espriella government.

es.title: Presidente de Ecopetrol: no hay fecha para el fracking en Colombia; faltan términos de referencia ambientales
es.summary: El presidente de Ecopetrol, Joaquín Gutiérrez, dijo a El Tiempo que los equipos técnicos de la compañía actualizan la prospectividad y estructuran los casos de negocio para yacimientos no convencionales, con base en información sísmica y de pozos adquirida en los últimos años. Señaló que por ahora no hay una fecha concreta para implementar el fracking en Colombia y que no es adecuado hablar de cronogramas de producción o inversiones definitivas hasta que concluyan los casos de negocio y los diagnósticos ambientales, sociales y de riesgos. Añadió que el ordenamiento jurídico actual no tiene una norma que permita una licencia ambiental para la etapa comercial de yacimientos no convencionales, pues aún está pendiente la expedición de los términos de referencia de los estudios de impacto ambiental. El medio recuerda que reactivar el fracking a través de Ecopetrol fue una promesa del Gobierno De la Espriella.

briefs.title: Bessent softens opposition to Huang's return at Nvidia, CNBC analysis says
briefs.summary: Nvidia's board reappointed Jensen Huang as CEO at President Trump's urging, saying it had received assurances from top U.S. officials and concluded his return was not a national security risk. A CNBC analysis says Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who on Nov. 15 had said the board should look outside the company, softened his stance over the weekend and appears to have lost the policy argument to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. Trump said he intervened because the stock market was falling, saying 'I watched our country lose $5 trillion because of a bad election.' The article says Congress will continue investigating potential violations involving Nvidia chips and Megaspeed.

es.title: Bessent suaviza su oposición al regreso de Huang a Nvidia, según análisis de CNBC
es.summary: La junta directiva de Nvidia volvió a nombrar a Jensen Huang como CEO por insistencia del presidente Trump, y dijo haber recibido garantías de altos funcionarios de EE. UU. y haber concluido que su regreso no era un riesgo para la seguridad nacional. Un análisis de CNBC señala que el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, quien el 15 de noviembre había dicho que la junta debía buscar un líder fuera de la empresa, suavizó su postura durante el fin de semana y parece haber perdido el debate de política frente al secretario de Comercio, Howard Lutnick. Trump dijo que intervino porque el mercado bursátil estaba cayendo, y afirmó: «Vi cómo nuestro país perdía US$5 billones por unas malas elecciones». El artículo indica que el Congreso seguirá investigando posibles violaciones relacionadas con chips de Nvidia y Megaspeed.

briefs.title: MSCI Colcap falls 6.24% in the week to Nov 20 and closes at 2,299.41 points
briefs.summary: The MSCI Colcap closed at 2,299.41 points on Nov 20, 2026, a weekly change of -6.24%, while the year-to-date change is +11.19%. Mineros fell 19.21%, ISA 15.33% and preferred Grupo Aval 12.61%, while Grupo Sura rose 7.15%, the best performer of the week. Weekly traded volume was COP 1.2 trillion, up 19.80% from COP 1 trillion the previous week. In its technical view, Valora Analitik places weekly resistance at 2,630 points and support at 2,240 points.

briefs.title: Ecopetrol reportedly plans to sell non-core assets to focus on oil and gas, sources say
briefs.summary: Valora Analitik reports, citing sources close to the company, that Ecopetrol's new management plans to sell non-strategic assets and buy hydrocarbon assets over the next four years. The sources did not say which assets would be sold. Whether the sale would include Ecopetrol's 51.4% stake in ISA has not been confirmed. Ecopetrol groups 128 companies, and the sources say news is expected in the short term.

briefs.title: Wall Street futures rebound after AI-led selloff as markets await Wednesday's PCE data
briefs.summary: US stock futures rose on Monday after a week that pushed the three main US indexes into correction territory: Nasdaq 100 futures gained 3.5%, S&P 500 futures 2.1% and Dow Jones futures 1.9%. In Asia, Taiwan's weighted index rose 2.4% after a 17.5% weekly drop, while South Korea's Kospi fell 3.3%. Brent futures were little changed at US$88.73 and WTI fell 1.2% to US$82.49 per barrel, with attacks in the Persian Gulf keeping supply concerns high. Spot gold rose 2.8% to US$3,635.33 per ounce, and investors are looking to Wednesday's October PCE inflation release.

audit.title: NY Fed's Williams says inflation work remains, to be tackled 'over time'

issues: Actor 'US borrowers' (impact: adverse) is not supported by the source. The source never mentions borrowers or borrowing costs. The claim that a hike 'would raise short-term borrowing costs' is the drafter's own inference about a rate increase that has not happened. Remove this actor or set its impact to 'undetermined' with a source-based reason. The same applies to the ES 'Prestatarios en EE. UU.' entry.

Third watch item: the note attributes to Williams a view that 'unemployment is edging lower'. In the source, 'unemployment edges lower' sits inside his outlook that inflation will subside in 2027 even as growth stays robust, so it reads as a forecast condition rather than a description of current data. Rephrase to match the source, for example 'inflation has continued to run too high' and 'the economy has remained strong', in both EN and ES.

audit.title: Ecopetrol's president says no date is set for fracking in Colombia, citing pending environmental rules

issues: The actor 'De la Espriella government' is given an 'adverse' impact without support in the source. The source reports only the CEO's statements that there is no date and that the terms of reference are pending. It does not say the government is harmed. Issuing those terms of reference is itself a government or regulatory task, and the source's image caption even suggests the government could reactivate fracking without Congress. The impact should be 'undetermined'.

The summary says production timelines and investments should not be discussed until the environmental, social and risk diagnostics are 'completed' (ES: 'concluyan'). The source says only until those diagnostics are 'adelantados' (carried out or advanced). 'Completed' applies only to the business-case structuring.

The Ecopetrol actor reason says environmental licenses 'cannot yet be requested' (ES: 'no pueden solicitarse'). The source says no current rule allows a license to be 'obtained' for the commercial stage. This is a slight overstatement.

The government actor reason refers to a 'missing regulatory framework' (ES: 'ausencia de un marco regulatorio'). The source specifies only that the terms of reference for the environmental impact studies are pending, so the reason generalizes beyond the source.

audit.title: Bessent softens opposition to Huang's return at Nvidia, CNBC analysis says
MSCI Colcap falls 6.24% in the week to Nov 20 and closes at 2,299.41 points

issues: Minor, non-blocking: the category 'Macro data' fits poorly, since this is a weekly equity-index and stock-performance report. 'Markets' or 'Equities' would be more accurate.

Minor, non-blocking: the summary omits the source's technical view that the index keeps an upward (bullish) trend on the weekly timeframe. Including it would give readers the context for the 2,630 resistance and 2,240 support levels.

audit.title: Ecopetrol reportedly plans to sell non-core assets to focus on oil and gas, sources say

issues: Minor: the Ecopetrol actor reason ('free capital for oil and gas', 'lose diversification') presents analyst Omar Suárez's views as general fact. In the source, the loss of diversification is his assessment of an ISA sale specifically. Consider attributing it to the analyst in both the EN and ES versions.

audit.title: Wall Street futures rebound after AI-led selloff as markets await Wednesday's PCE data

issues: Nvidia actor (EN and ES): the reason says 'the source says' Nvidia was under pressure because of doubts over AI valuations and debt-financed data center investment. The source only says 'Nvidia también estuvo bajo presión' and gives no cause for it. The AI-valuation and debt-financed data center doubts appear in the Asia-Pacific section about regional confidence, not about Nvidia. The causal attribution is unsupported. Limit the reason to the source's statement that Nvidia was under pressure during the selloff.
Minor: category 'Other' undersells the content. The brief covers US equity futures, Fed-preferred inflation data (PCE), oil and gold, so a markets category would fit better.

unsupported.text: The source gives no data on rates, fees or credit quality. / La fuente no da datos sobre tasas, comisiones ni calidad crediticia.
unsupported.why: Contradicted on rates. The source gives interest rate discounts: 30% on Más Puntos supermarket and pharmacy purchases and 20% on Más Destinos phone purchases. The brief also notes 'some interest rate discounts'.

unsupported.text: Current cardholders, about 160,000, and the bank's sales staff feel it first, since both must adjust to the new range. / Los tarjetahabientes actuales, cerca de 160.000, y la fuerza de ventas del banco lo sienten primero, pues ambos deben adaptarse al nuevo portafolio.
unsupported.why: The source does not say what happens to existing cardholders, and the brief lists this as an unknown. The claim that they must adjust and feel it first is not backed.

unsupported.text: Rate-sensitive assets in the US usually react before others.
unsupported.why: This is a general claim about market behavior that the source, brief and historical evidence do not back. It is stated as fact, not as a conditional mechanism.
